content: LLM-as-judge: use analytic rubrics (criterion-by-criterion) over holistic for debuggability; binary/rubric scoring beats multi-point Likert scales which add noise; pairwise comparison +8% human agreement over absolute scoring. Known biases: positional (favor first), verbosity (favor longer), calibration drift. Mitigations: randomize order, hide model identity, structured JSON output, spell out edge cases in rubric. Same model/criterion can vary 0.40-0.75 alignment based on rubric structure.
